data.narrative:
Virtus Solis is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $5.2M to date. The broader sector peer set comprises nine private companies and one public comparable (LNZA), including later-stage ventures such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer universe lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tier characteristics to support a reliable peer-median approach—only zero datapoints met the narrow filtering criteria across stage and tier alignment.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation lens. Using total raised ($5.2M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to next-stage capitalization yields an implied valuation of $13M. This reflects observed progression patterns in early-stage frontier technology ventures, though applied to a single-company, limited-precedent dataset.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $15M (median $13M), with material uncertainty concentrated in two areas: the absence of direct peer benchmarks limits calibration of the stage-progression multiple to sector-specific conditions, and undisclosed current valuation precludes confirmation of the $5.2M raise-as-proxy assumption. Additional Climate & Energy seed or early-growth stage comparables would materially tighten this range.
